description: Write and return a deterministic Requirements Traceability Matrix. Status comes only from the local graph and gap-fill ledger: Proven, Runtime-covered, Associated signal, No integration signal, Reproven, or Generated-unverifiable. No LLM calls.

base_ref.description: Optional PR/diff scope. Restricts rows to behaviors touched vs this ref.

limit.description: Optional max rows to emit. Markdown defaults to 500 rows; JSON/CSV are uncapped unless set.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.
